(a) if an object becomes caught between the handrail and the handrail guard

(b) if an object approaches the area between the handrail and handrail guard

For those units that rely on an opening of the balustrade to prevent entrapment, all handrail entry devices shall be operative whenever the handrails are operating. The device shall be of the manual reset type.
